basic_details.job_title: BSF Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 34 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Border Security Force (BSF) has announced 34 vacancies for Sub-Inspector (Medic), Sub-Inspector (Lab Technician) and Sub-Inspector (Physiotherapist) posts on a deputation basis under advertisement number 11/63/2026/Med Dte /BSF/7298-7658. Eligible candidates must send their offline applications by post to the Inspector General/Director (Medical), Directorate General, BSF on or before 9 December 2026. The posts carry a pay of Pay Matrix level 6, and qualifications vary according to the post as specified in the official notification. The selection process consists of a medical fitness examinatio

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions for Sub-Inspector (Medic): | Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces or the Central Government or the State Government or the Union Territory Administration holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or with six years regular service in level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) in the pay-matrix in the parent cadre or department. Possessing Basic Nursing Assistant or Medic Course; Advance Nursing Assistant or Advance Medic Course; and experience of minimum six years as Nursing Assistant in hundred bedded Hospital or institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government or Central Armed Police Forces Hospitals. Must be medically fit. | Eligibility Conditions for Sub-Inspector (Lab Technician): | Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces or the Central Government or the State Government or the Union Territory Administration holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or with six years regular service in level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) in the pay-matrix in the parent cadre or department. 12th Class passed from a recognised Board and Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician or Technology of two years duration from an institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government. Experience of minimum six years as Laboratory Technician from a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or minimum hundred bedded hospital or an institution recognised by the Central Government or a State Government. Must be medically fit. | Eligibility Conditions for Sub-Inspector (Physiotherapist): | Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces or the Central Government or the State Government or the Union Territory Administration holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or with six years regular service in level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) in the pay-matrix in the parent cadre or department. 12th Class passed from a recognised Board and Diploma in Physiotherapy of two years duration from an institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government. Experience of minimum six years as Physiotherapist from a Physiotherapy Centre or minimum hundred bedded Hospital or Institute recognised by the Central Government or the State Government. Must be medically fit.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Nominations of eligible and willing candidates must be forwarded through proper channel with duly attested copy of CR dossiers/APARs of the last five years to the following address: Inspector General/Director (Medical)Directorate General, BSFBlock No. 9, Level-04, East Block, Sector-1, R K PuramNew Delhi-110066

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Conditions for Sub-Inspector (Medic): Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces or the Central Government or the State Government or the Union Territory Administration holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or with six years regular service in level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) in the pay-matrix in the parent cadre or department. Possessing Basic Nursing Assistant or Medic Course; Advance Nursing Assistant or Advance Medic Course; and experience of minimum six years as Nursing Assistant in hundred bedded Hospital or institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government or Central Armed Police Forces Hospitals. Must be medically fit. Eligibility Conditions for Sub-Inspector (Lab Technician): Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces or the Central Government or the State Government or the Union Territory Administration holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or with six years regular service in level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) in the pay-matrix in the parent cadre or department. 12th Class passed from a recognised Board and Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician or Technology of two years duration from an institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government. Experience of minimum six years as Laboratory Technician from a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or minimum hundred bedded hospital or an institution recognised by the Central Government or a State Government. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly attested copies of CR dossiers/APARs for the last five years Bio-data in the prescribed proforma Certificate to be furnished by the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority confirming integrity, medical category, and absence of disciplinary/vigilance cases

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is on a deputation basis. Candidates are evaluated based on their service records (CR dossiers/APARs for the last five years), integrity, and a medical fitness examination.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for BSF Sub-Inspector recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of nominations is 9 December 2026, which is the 60th day from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces, Central Government, State Government, or Union Territory Administration holding analogous posts on regular basis or possessing specified years of regular service in level-5, along with the required educational qualifications and experience, are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not be exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be enclosed with the offline application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose duly attested copies of CR dossiers/APARs for the last five years along with the proforma bio-data and the certificate furnished by the employer or head of office.
